content.text: This parser has one 200-line function. Can we simplify it without changing behavior?

First pin current behavior with table-driven tests, especially malformed and boundary inputs. Then extract tokenization, structural validation, and model construction into small pure functions while keeping the public entry point unchanged.
Would you introduce a parser class?
Only if parsing needs shared mutable cursor state. If each phase can accept and return explicit values, module-level pure functions will be easier to test and reason about.
